_notes.simp_case: One exported part, STL in mm in the same frame as the support, load and stress-region boxes. Linear isotropic static elasticity. Young's modulus MPa; forces N (total per patch, shared over selected nodes). One simultaneous load case. Baseline: a 40x8x8 mm beam held at x=0 under 1 N at x=40. E=1000 MPa is a test material, not a filament recommendation. Mesh 1.5 mm, refined to 0.975 mm; Poisson 0.3. Stress sampled only between x=8 and x=32 to exclude clamp and load singularities.
_notes.simp_volume_limit_mm3: Maximum volume of the exported connected solid in mm^3. Baseline 2560 against 3000; doubled width is 5120 and must fail.
_notes.simp_displacement_limit_mm: Maximum displacement magnitude anywhere in the exported part, mm. Baseline around 0.063 against 0.1; half-modulus control around 0.126 and must fail.
_notes.simp_stress_limit_mpa: Maximum von Mises stress in the explicitly selected stress region, MPa. Baseline about 0.28 against 1; tenfold load about 2.8 and must fail. The regions excluded from this assertion still require other checks.
